name: LLM-QAT KV cache quantization (4-bit KV inside a QAT regime)
bits: 4-bit KV cache, alongside quantized weights and activations
activation_scheme: Not an activation scheme - the KV cache is quantized as part of quantization-aware training with straight-through estimators, so the network is trained knowing the cache will be 4-bit. The paper treats KV quantization as essential rather than optional, on the grounds that it is what actually enables long-sequence throughput at current model sizes.
notes: Separate record for the KV dimension of LLM-QAT because KV-cache quantization is a distinct decision from weight quantization and the repo's schema has no way to express 'quantizes the KV cache' except through bits and activation_scheme free text. Do not fold this into the llm-qat record: that record is about the training regime, this one is about the cache format, and a reader deciding how many bits to spend on KV should not have to read a QAT paper to find out. Symmetric key/value bits here (4 and 4) - the asymmetric alternative is KIVI's 2-bit-key / 4-bit-value. Request the parent add a kv-cache enum family so records like this one stop needing a weight-format enum value as a stand-in. SCHEME RECLASSIFIED (parent agent, 2026-10-03): scheme was 'bitsandbytes-nf4' (a proxy recorded while the enum lacked a legal value) and is now 'kv-cache-quant'.
